source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the temperate deciduous forest (PDF 241-246).

blocks.text: Yeh jangalat nam pahari ilaqon mein ugte hain jahan wazeh mausam hain, jin mein thandi sardi bhi hai jab darakht patte gira dete hain (deciduous).

blocks.caption: temperate deciduous jangal ka khaaka
rows: shimali ilaqe: Shogran, Neelam Valley, Murree, Kaghan ke hisse
zarkhez, surmai bhoori mitti jis mein organic maadda (humus) zyada
moatadil, 4 se 30 C; 750-1500 mm salana barish
Taxus baccata (yew), Pinus wallichiana (blue pine), Cedrus deodara (deodar); jhaariyan jaise Berberis lyceum (sumbal)
rhesus bandar (Macaca mulatta), kaala reechh, leopard cat, bheriye, bohat se parinde
kharab: bohat se bare shikari khatam; lakri ki sanat aur kheti ka dabao

blocks.alt: Barfeele pahar, bohat se conifer darakht, charagah aur nala. Labelled janwar: aage kala reechh (black bear), kaai wali chattan par rhesus bandar, chattan ki choti par leopard cat aur charagah mein bhediye.
blocks.caption: Figure 25.11: Temperate deciduous jangal aur us ke numainda paude aur janwar (kitab ki tasveer, Figure 25.11, ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: temperate deciduous jangal ka aik paudha aur aik janwar batayein.
blocks.explanation: Maslan Taxus baccata (yew) aur rhesus bandar (Macaca mulatta).
